- EEE/ ECE Role Overview: We are seeking a skilled and motivated Hardware Design Engineer with hands-on experience in high-speed digital design and protocols (such as MIPI, USB 3.x, PCIe, Ethernet, or HDMI). The ideal candidate will contribute to the design, development, and validation of high-performance hardware systems with a strong emphasis on signal integrity, layout design, and compliance to protocol standards. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
To architect, design and develop embedded hardware for Camera Based Application by means of the following: Requirement gathering based on discussion with customer or Lead Selection of suitable components for the above requirements Design analysis Schematics design, optimized BOM generation Interact with the PCB Team and get the layout completed with the following items followed Standard guidelines for best EMI/EMC performance Standard DFM guidelines Testing, bring up and Design validation Completion of doing EMI/EMC pre-compliance testing at standard laboratories Handover to production team for mass production Laying out production test plan considering the test jig feasibilities and with the help of a software resource Supporting production team for production issues. Key Technical Skills Required: Strong electrical/electronic basics (Good in fundamentals like transistors, resistors, inductors, capacitors, op-amps) Should have worked in DC

Knowledge in PCB layer stack-up, PCB routing, Signal integrity, Power Integrity, thermal simulation, environmental tests, FCC, and EMI/EMC (EFT, ESD, CS, CE, RE, RS) compliance testing. Should have done Testing and validation of designed boards. Preferred Attributes: Exposure to camera or video-based products (e.g., camera interface via MIPI CSI). Knowledge of thermal and power management in hardware design. Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills. Team player with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset. - EEE/ ECE Role Overview: e-con Systems is looking for a passionate and technically sound Lead Firmware Engineer to spearhead the development and integration of low-level software components across embedded platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Linux kernel development, Linux internals, and device driver development for custom hardware solutions, especially for embedded vision products. As a Lead Engineer, you will mentor junior team members, influence architectural decisions, and work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-performance firmware for cutting-edge camera systems. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Key Technical Skills Required: Must have experience with Embedded Linux on ARM processors (i MX6/i MX7/i MX8/Tegra platforms). Experience with Kernel and device driver development. Experience with I2C, SPI, I2S, UART, USB, Flash RAMs, LCD, SD cards, etc., Experience with C or C++ programming in 8, 16 and 32-bit embedded environments and knowledge of assembly along with shell script. Extensive experience with software engineering processes and tools. Experience and comfort with lab tools such as debuggers, logic analyzers and oscilloscopes. Strong analytical and logical ability. Strong written and verbal communication and project management skills. Think outside the box when developing solution. A passion for creating and building things. Experience with Video devices, Image sensors and image processors is desirable. Experience with Audio and Video codecs is a plus. Experience with UVC and UAC protocols is a plus. Experience with camera interface, MIPI protocol is a plus. Testing experience of knowledge about EMI, ESD, Temperature etc.. Having at least one of the above skills is key. Roles and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Should be capable of preparing the proposal based on customer requirements Should be capable of executing the project from requirement gathering to final product/service deliverables Responsible to architect, design, development, implementation, testing and delivering on time Should be capable of managing 3 to 4 sub-ordinates Responsible for team collaboration, reduce attrition and skills development Capable of working with tools/applications running on Linux for development and debug, applications for field upgrades as well as tools for manufacturing and production Should be capable of interacting with other teams and get the work on time. Apply Here JOB ID: e-con006 Job Synopsis: Position: Application Engineer (Surveillance Business Unit) Geography: Global (customer interactions worldwide) Location: Chennai Experience: 2 to 5 years Educational Qualification : Bachelor’s degree in ECE / CSE or related field Role Overview: As an Application Engineer at e-con Systems, you will be the technical interface between customers and internal teams
- ensuring successful integration and deployment of e-con’s camera modules, embedded vision systems, and AI-enabled surveillance products. You’ll engage from pre-sales to production, providing solution proposals, design integration support, and field-level debugging assistance. This role is ideal for engineers who are technically hands-on, customer-oriented, and eager to grow in both system-level problem-solving and solution ownership. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Pre-Sales & Solution Definition: Collaborate with Sales and Product Management to understand customer requirements and propose suitable camera or embedded vision solutions using e-con Systems’ products. Participate in technical discussions, requirement gathering, and feasibility assessments, translating customer needs into clear technical deliverables. Support customer proof-of-concept (Po C) and evaluation activities to achieve design wins. Integration & Design Support: Guide customers on hardware and software integration, including camera bring-up, image tuning, and performance optimization on embedded platforms. Work hands-on with NVIDIA Jetson, Qualcomm, or ARM-based embedded platforms, debugging and configuring Linux drivers (V4L2, GStreamer, MIPI, USB, GMSL, Ethernet). Collaborate closely with internal engineering and QA teams to resolve issues and enhance product robustness. Production & Post-Deployment Support: Assist customers during transition from prototype to production — resolving manufacturing, firmware, or image-quality-related challenges. Track and escalate recurring field issues, providing structured feedback to R&D for continuous improvement. Maintain strong documentation for customer configurations and integration guides. Product Enablement & Knowledge Sharing: Validate new camera modules, features, and SDK updates; provide actionable feedback to product and engineering teams. Conduct technical trainings for distributors, customers, and partners to enhance adoption of e-con’s products. Contribute to application notes, FAQs, and demo content in collaboration with the marketing and technical writing teams. Technical Skills: Solid understanding of Embedded Systems, Linux (kernel & user space), and driver-level debugging. Programming experience in C/C++ and Python, with working knowledge of shell scripting. Familiarity with camera and imaging technologies — Image sensors, ISPs, color tuning, exposure control, and video formats. Hands-on experience with vision interfaces (USB 3.0, MIPI CSI-2, GMSL, Gig E Vision) and media frameworks (V4L2, GStreamer, Open CV). Experience with AI inference on edge devices (Jetson / Qualcomm / NPU platforms) is a strong plus. Understanding of networked video streaming, latency, and bandwidth optimization desirable for surveillance use cases. Behavioral & Business Competencies: Customer-centric mindset – ability to translate technical complexity into business impact and actionable insights. Strong communication skills – articulate technical details clearly in written and verbal formats. Analytical problem-solving – structured debugging, root-cause analysis, and issue ownership. Collaboration & cross-functional alignment – comfortable working with Sales, Product, R&D, and QA teams. Adaptability – can handle changing priorities across geographies and projects. Continuous learning – proactive in exploring new camera technologies, edge AI frameworks, and embedded toolchains. Hands-on attitude – thrives in lab testing, Po C building, and direct customer interactions. Documentation discipline – maintains organized records of test setups, configurations, and resolutions. What Makes This Role Exciting: Be part of the Business Unit driving next-generation Smart Surveillance solutions. Work directly with global OEMs, system integrators, and AI solution providers. Opportunity to influence product roadmaps through direct customer feedback and field experience. Exposure to end-to-end camera solution lifecycle – from concept to deployment.
